## Description {#details}

<p>This file provides a collection of visitors which walk the (instruction) uses of a pointer.</p>


<p>These visitors all provide the same essential behavior as an InstVisitor with similar template-based flexibility and implementation strategies.</p>


<p>These can be used, for example, to quickly analyze the uses of an alloca, global variable, or function argument.</p>


<p>FIXME: Provide a variant which doesn't track offsets and is cheaper.</p>
